title: List MDO threat policy rules that combine recipient condition types
summary: Read-only Exchange Online PowerShell that lists anti-phish, Safe Links, Safe Attachments, anti-spam and anti-malware rules using more than one of SentTo, SentToMemberOf and RecipientDomainIs — the rules whose scope widens when Microsoft switches recipient conditions from AND to OR.
code:
Connect-ExchangeOnline
$rules = @()
$rules += Get-AntiPhishRule          | Select-Object @{n='Type';e={'AntiPhish'}}, Name, State, Priority, SentTo, SentToMemberOf, RecipientDomainIs
$rules += Get-SafeLinksRule          | Select-Object @{n='Type';e={'SafeLinks'}}, Name, State, Priority, SentTo, SentToMemberOf, RecipientDomainIs
$rules += Get-SafeAttachmentRule     | Select-Object @{n='Type';e={'SafeAttachments'}}, Name, State, Priority, SentTo, SentToMemberOf, RecipientDomainIs
$rules += Get-HostedContentFilterRule| Select-Object @{n='Type';e={'AntiSpam'}}, Name, State, Priority, SentTo, SentToMemberOf, RecipientDomainIs
$rules += Get-MalwareFilterRule      | Select-Object @{n='Type';e={'AntiMalware'}}, Name, State, Priority, SentTo, SentToMemberOf, RecipientDomainIs

# Rules that combine more than one recipient condition type are the ones AND -> OR widens
$rules | ForEach-Object {
  $used  = @(); if ($_.SentTo) {$used+='Users'}; if ($_.SentToMemberOf) {$used+='Groups'}; if ($_.RecipientDomainIs) {$used+='Domains'}
  $_ | Add-Member -NotePropertyName ConditionTypes -NotePropertyValue ($used -join '+') -PassThru
} | Where-Object { $_.ConditionTypes -like '*+*' } |
  Sort-Object Type, Priority |
  Format-Table Type, Name, State, Priority, ConditionTypes -AutoSize
notes: Read-only. Safe Links and Safe Attachments cmdlets exist only in tenants licensed for Defender for Office 365.
Compute the actual AND vs OR populations before you change anything.
